ce5634882978: Why does Wendy choose to slip into bed instead of covering Mother’s eyes?

23ee5b833d1a: What does Lydia’s offer to “treat” her sisters reveal about her?

4a2df2d10657: What two kinds of resistance does Russell say a reformer faces?

1757d32f2d03: What does this passage reveal about Crusoe’s character?

Because it was officially named City

4e06b563a6ec: Why was Heilmann’s invention so valuable?

902a39451958: Why is Edward “agitated” when Marianne asks him to escort them?

23ce6b48cde3: What does Poole’s harsh “Hold your tongue!” reveal?

fb839a668d16: What does the word “slaved” suggest about Tess’s work?
